sentence: At N = 160 the tuned execution rule gives 17.80 ms for independent DQN (training runs 17.14–19.24 ms) and 17.49 ms for VDN (17.29–17.61 ms); with ε-greedy execution they give 24.58 and 18.23 ms. At N = 80 they give 15.04 and 15.10 ms, and with the deadline-only mask at N = 240 and 320 independent DQN gives 18.21 and 18.19 ms and VDN 18.02 and 18.11 ms.
